newsitem.title: USA: Fred Meyer President Lerew III resigns.
newsitem.headline: Fred Meyer President Lerew III resigns.

text.p: Fred Meyer Inc said its president and chief operating officer Curt Lerew III resigned to pursue other interests.
Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Robert Miller has assumed these responibilities, the company said.
"We want to thank Curt for his service to the Company and the community and wish him well," Miller said.
Lerew joined Fred Meyer in October 1991 as senior vice president of the food group and in June 1996 succeeded Cy Green as president, it said.
Fred Meyer is a regional retailer of general merchandise, food, apparel, fine jewelry and home improvement products.
